Package controller.album

Class AlbumController

java.lang.Object
controller.album.AlbumController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AlbumController extends Object implements Serializable
Singleton controller for managing album-related operations such as creating photos, generating thumbnails, and interacting with AlbumViewController. Implements Serializable to allow saving and restoring state if necessary.
